name: Cream Cheese Marmalade Slider Bento Box with Jello, Grapes, Corn Nuts, Cauliflower & Thousand Island

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Place cauliflower in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Wash and dry grapes. Place grapes and corn nuts in the small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup red grapes
⅓ cup corn nuts

instructions.primary_message: Place dressing in a small container with a lid. Place dressing and gelatin snack cup in the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp Thousand Island dressing
1 (3.3 oz) gelatin snack cup

instructions.primary_message: Place rolls on a flat surface, then slice crosswise to separate into halves. Spread the bottom half of each with cream cheese and marmalade, then close with the top halves of the rolls. Add sliders to the large compartment of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 Hawaiian sweet rolls
3 tbsp whipped cream cheese spread
2 tbsp orange marmalade

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
